# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a tech job to pursue independent projects and life ambitions.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool that orchestrates autonomous software development using Claude agents with Linear integration and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide covering color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual spaces, and practical design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to actual spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed explanation of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, auditory feedback, critical periods, and regional dialects.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and how Web Mercator dominates online mapping.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores the chemistry of cold light, evolutionary adaptations, and biological applications of bioluminescence in deep ocean organisms.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo boy's insect collecting inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Competitive Pokémon Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built competitive Pokémon's ruleset through datamining hidden mechanics and community governance.
- [Pokémon Red and Blue Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous Gen 1 bugs including MissingNo., the unreachable truck, and the Mew glitch.
